achievements.name: It wakes
achievements.description: Raise a character level to 10.

steps: Play any Survivor or Killer and spend Bloodpoints on their Bloodweb.
Reach character level 10 — levelling a single character is the fastest route.

achievements.name: Zealous
achievements.description: In a public match, get more than 8K blood points in one scoring category.

steps: Concentrate on one scoring category — repairing Generators as a Survivor, or Sacrificing as a Killer, is the easiest to push high.
Finish the trial with more than 8,000 Bloodpoints banked in that single category.

achievements.name: Skillful
achievements.description: Boost any perk to level 3.

steps: Open a character's Bloodweb and spend Bloodpoints on the same Perk three times.
Any Perk counts, including the free universal ones.

achievements.name: Getting the hang of it
achievements.description: Raise your grade for the first time.

steps: Play a public match and earn enough Emblems for at least one grade pip.
Grades start at Ash IV; the achievement fires as soon as you rise for the first time.

achievements.name: Not half bad
achievements.description: Raise a character level to 25.

steps: Keep spending Bloodpoints on one character's Bloodweb.
Level 25 arrives after roughly 20 to 30 matches on that character.

achievements.name: Survival Treasures
achievements.description: In a public match, escape while bringing a new item to the campfire.

steps: Find an Item in a chest or on the ground during the trial — do not bring one in yourself.
Escape through an Exit Gate or the Hatch while still holding it, so it is banked after the match.

achievements.name: Apt Survivor
achievements.description: Start a public match with a full survivor loadout.

steps: In the Survivor loadout screen, fill all four Perk slots.
Start any public trial — the achievement unlocks the moment the match begins.

achievements.name: No one left behind
achievements.description: In a public match, rescue someone after at least one gate has opened.

steps: Wait until at least one Exit Gate is powered and opened.
Unhook a Survivor, or pick up a downed one, after that point.

achievements.name: Sorted
achievements.description: In a public match, spend most of the trial injured (more than 50%) and live to tell the story.

steps: Stay injured for more than half the trial — do not heal early, or the timer will not reach 50%.
Reach the Exit Gate or Hatch and escape alive.
warnings: The game measures the whole trial, so healing yourself at the first opportunity is the usual way this one is lost.

achievements.name: Bloody Millionaire
achievements.description: Accumulate a total of 1 million blood points. (blood points can be spent before reaching the total)

steps: Earn Bloodpoints in public matches — the counter tracks everything you have ever earned, not your current balance.
Keep playing normally; 1,000,000 Bloodpoints is roughly 100 to 150 trials.

achievements.name: Backdoor Escape
achievements.description: Escape from a Trial through the Hatch.

steps: Survive until you are the last Survivor left in the trial, which is when the Hatch becomes usable.
Find the Hatch and hold the interaction to escape through it.
warnings: The Hatch cannot be used while other Survivors are still alive, so let the others go first.

achievements.name: I
achievements.description: Reach prestige Level I with any character.

steps: Level a single character to level 50 on their Bloodweb.
Prestige that character once from the character/Bloodweb screen.
warnings: Prestige resets that character's Bloodweb progress, so do it on someone you are not in the middle of building.

achievements.name: Perfect Escape
achievements.description: In a public match, as a survivor, complete with at least 5000 blood points in each score category.

steps: The Survivor categories are Objectives, Survival, Altruism and Boldness — spread your play across all four.
Finish the trial (escaping or dying both count) with at least 5,000 in every category; a long, busy match does it naturally.

achievements.name: Nerves of steel
achievements.description: In public matches, get a total of 500 successful Skill-Checks.

steps: Hit the Skill-Check quick-time prompts that appear while repairing, healing or cleansing.
They are cumulative across matches; the smaller Great Skill-Check zone also counts.

achievements.name: Agonizing Escape
achievements.description: While in the Dying State, escape from a Trial by crawling out of the Exit Gates or into the Hatch.

steps: Do not let anyone heal you — stay in the Dying State and crawl the entire way.
Crawl out through an open Exit Gate, or take the Hatch while still downed.
warnings: Being healed, unhooked or picked up at any point voids the attempt.

achievements.name: I've got your back
achievements.description: In public matches, save a total of 50 survivors from death.

steps: Unhook Survivors before they die, or pick up a downed one before they bleed out.
50 rescues is cumulative, so every unhook in every match counts toward it.

achievements.name: The Grand Sacrifice
achievements.description: In a public match, get 4 sacrifices in a single match.

steps: Hook each of the four Survivors three times, or hook them and let them die on the hook.
Getting all four sacrificed in one trial is the condition — an early-pressure Killer such as The Trapper makes it far easier.

achievements.name: Risk it all
achievements.description: In a public match, as a survivor, use a visceral item or add-on without using a protective ward.

steps: Bring a high-rarity Item or add-on into a public trial and equip it without burning a Protective Ward offering.
Use the item during the match — the achievement fires on first use, an escape is not required.

achievements.name: Handyman
achievements.description: In public matches, repair generators for a total of 100 full repairs.

steps: Contribute to Generator repairs — a full repair is 90 charges, and only your own charges count.
100 full repairs is cumulative; joining a generator someone else started still adds your share.

achievements.name: Perfect Killing
achievements.description: In a public match, as a killer, complete with at least 5000 blood points in each score category.

steps: The Killer categories are Brutality, Deviousness, Hunter and Sacrifice — spread your play across all four.
Finish a full match with at least 5,000 in each; win slowly with chases, power hits and breakables rather than ending the trial early.

achievements.name: Make Some Noise
achievements.description: In public matches, scream 50 times.

steps: Screams are the Survivor reaction to being hit, downed or hooked, and to several Killer powers and Perks.
Play Survivor and get hit, or run a Killer whose power forces screams, until the 50 total is reached.

achievements.name: II
achievements.description: Reach prestige Level II with any character.

steps: Prestige any character once, then level them back to 50 and prestige again.
The count follows the same character, but you can also spread prestiges across different ones.

achievements.name: Preemptive Strike
achievements.description: Hook a Survivor in a public match before any generators have been fully repaired.

steps: Play a Killer with early-game pressure and find a Survivor in the opening seconds of the trial.
Hook them before the Survivors finish their first Generator.

achievements.name: Apt Killer
achievements.description: Start a public match with a full killer loadout.

steps: In the Killer loadout screen, fill all four Perk slots.
Start any public trial — the achievement unlocks as the match begins.

achievements.name: Resurgence
achievements.description: Heal other Survivors for 10 health states while at least 3 Survivors are injured, dying or hooked.

steps: Heal team-mates while at least three Survivors are injured, dying or hooked — a badly losing trial is the easiest setup.
Ten health states is cumulative and carries across matches.

achievements.name: Humanitarian
achievements.description: Affect other Survivors with positive status effects 50 times in public matches.

steps: Positive status effects come from auras, healing items and team Perks such as Prove Thyself or Leader.
Apply 50 of them across matches; buffing Perks that touch nearby team-mates are the most repeatable source.

achievements.name: III
achievements.description: Reach prestige Level III with any character.

steps: Take a character through two prestiges, level them to 50 once more, then prestige a third time.
Progress on any character counts toward this.

achievements.name: Healthy Obsession
achievements.description: Heal other Survivors marked as the Obsession for a total of 10 health states in public matches.

steps: Each trial marks one Survivor as the Obsession, shown as the black-and-white portrait in the HUD.
Heal that Survivor for ten health states in total across matches.

achievements.name: Vulture
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with an item that another player brought into the match.

steps: Let another Survivor drop or lose their Item, then pick it up.
Escape through an Exit Gate while carrying it — an Item you brought yourself does not count.

achievements.name: Close Shave
achievements.description: Dodge basic attacks or projectiles 100 times in public matches.

steps: A dodge is evading a Killer's attack as it lands — stepping past the swing or reaching a window or pallet first.
100 dodges is cumulative; sprint Perks such as Dead Hard or Sprint Burst make them much easier to bank.

achievements.name: Engineer
achievements.description: In public matches, repair a Generator in the Damage state , 50 Times. One time per generator.

steps: Wait for a Killer to kick a Generator into the damaged state, then repair it back up.
Only one repair per Generator per match counts toward the 50, so this needs many trials.

achievements.name: Blood on your hands
achievements.description: Kill your first Survivor by your own hands.

steps: Play a Killer that can kill directly rather than sacrifice — bring a Memento Mori offering, or use a Killer with an in-built kill such as The Shape or The Pig.
Kill one Survivor outright during the trial; a sacrifice or a bleed-out does not count.

achievements.name: Medic
achievements.description: In public matches, heal others for a total of 100 health states.

steps: Heal other Survivors — med-kits, healing Perks and unhooking all add health states to the counter.
100 is cumulative across matches, so build a Survivor around healing and keep playing them.

achievements.name: Working Overtime
achievements.description: In a single public match, repair generators for at least 300 seconds.

steps: Spend 300 seconds (five minutes) repairing Generators inside one trial.
Bring a repair Perk or a toolbox and stay on Generators; a slow, long match is required.

achievements.name: Escape Artist
achievements.description: In a public match, successfully escape the hook and escape.

steps: Get off a hook by yourself — a self-unhook, Deliverance, or a lucky 4% attempt.
Then reach an Exit Gate or the Hatch and escape in the same match.
warnings: Being rescued by a team-mate does not count; you must free yourself.

achievements.name: Honor the Bloodline
achievements.description: In public matches, reveal the Killer's aura for a total of 60 seconds in a single trial.

steps: Run aura-reading Perks or Items and keep the Killer's outline visible for a total of 60 seconds.
All 60 seconds must be banked inside one trial — the counter resets between matches.
communityNotes: Contrary to the wording, this also works as the Killer: revealing your own Aura counts, including companion links such as Victor to Charlotte and Killer pairs in 2v8.
warnings: The 60 seconds do not carry over between trials, so build for constant aura reads.

achievements.name: III-50
achievements.description: Reach prestige Level III-50 with any character.

steps: Prestige a character to III, then level them back to 50 without prestiging again.
III-50 is the cap, so the achievement fires as the final Bloodweb level is spent.

achievements.name: Every Last Drop
achievements.description: Deplete 30 items in public matches.

steps: Use an Item until its charges run out — med-kits, toolboxes, flashlights and keys all count.
30 depleted Items is cumulative, and you do not need to escape for the depletion to count.

achievements.name: Near-Death Experience
achievements.description: In public matches, get downed only once and escape the match alive, 25 times.

steps: In a trial, be put into the Dying State no more than once and still escape alive.
Repeat 25 times — playing cautiously once the gates are powered is the reliable way to bank these.

achievements.name: Cherish your Life
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in The Game's Bathroom and live to tell the story.

steps: On the Gideon Meat Plant map, find the Generator inside the Bathroom, on the lower level.
Finish repairing it and then escape the trial alive.

achievements.name: Shock Therapy
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator on the second floor of the Disturbed Ward and escape.

steps: On the Disturbed Ward map, find the Generator on the building's second floor.
Complete the repair and escape through an Exit Gate or the Hatch.

achievements.name: Unforgettable Getaway
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Chalet and live to tell the tale.

steps: Find the Generator inside the Chalet, the large lodge building on the Ormond map.
Finish the repair and then escape the trial alive.

achievements.name: Operation: Survival
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Treatment Theatre’s operation theatre and escape.

steps: On the Treatment Theatre map, find the Generator inside the operation theatre.
Finish repairing it and escape the trial.

achievements.name: All Aboard
achievements.description: In a public match, activate the Foghorn by repairing the generator in the Steamboat and escape.

steps: Find the Generator inside the Steamboat and complete the repair — that is what sounds the Foghorn.
Then escape the trial.

achievements.name: First to the Punch
achievements.description: Down 30 Survivors next to raised pallets in public matches.

steps: Chase Survivors around pallets and down them while the pallet is still standing — not after it has been dropped.
30 downs is cumulative, so chase Survivors toward pallet loops every match.

achievements.name: With Scars to Show
achievements.description: Go from healthy to injured during a chase and escape. Do this 50 times in public matches.

steps: Get hit from healthy to injured while actively being chased, then escape the trial alive.
Both halves must happen in the same match — repeat 50 times.

achievements.name: Expert survivor
achievements.description: Reach survivor online grade Silver I.

steps: Play Survivor in public matches and keep earning Emblems without losing pips.
Silver I sits two full grade tiers above the starting rank and comes from consistent escapes and saves.

achievements.name: Outrun Evil
achievements.description: In a public match, crawl your way out through the hatch.

steps: Become the last Survivor alive and get put into the Dying State.
Crawl to the Hatch and take it — do not let anyone heal you first.

achievements.name: Leapfrog
achievements.description: In public matches, jump over a pallet or through a window during a chase, 200 times.

steps: The vault must happen during a chase — running a loop with windows and pallets is the whole method.
200 vaults is cumulative; the fast-vault prompt makes each one count.

achievements.name: Old West Oasis
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Saloon and escape.

steps: On the Dead Dawg Saloon map, find the Generator inside the Saloon building.
Finish repairing it and escape the trial.

achievements.name: Escaping the Nightmare
achievements.description: In public matches, open the exit gate 35 times as a Survivor.

steps: Once the last Generator is done, reach an Exit Gate and hold the interaction to open it yourself.
A team-mate opening the gate for you does not count toward your total — open 35 of them.

achievements.name: Ancestor's Rite
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Family Residence and live to tell the tale.

steps: Find the Generator inside the Family Residence building.
Finish the repair and then escape the trial alive.

achievements.name: Cottage Owner
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Mother's Dwelling and live to tell the story.

steps: Find the Generator inside the Mother's Dwelling, the main farmhouse on Coldwind Farm.
Finish the repair and then escape the trial alive.

achievements.name: Classy Act
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in Midwich School's music room or chem lab and escape.

steps: On the Midwich Elementary School map, find the Generator in either the music room or the chemistry lab.
Finish the repair and escape the trial — either of the two rooms satisfies the condition.

achievements.name: Gifts for the Fog
achievements.description: In a public match, burn a Visceral offering.

steps: Equip any Offering in the loadout's Offering slot.
Start a public trial — the Offering is burned at the start of the match.

achievements.name: Item of Obsession
achievements.description: In a public match, as the killer's obsession, escape as the last survivor without getting hit.

steps: Become the Obsession — the Survivor with the black-and-white portrait — which Perks such as Sole Survivor or Object of Obsession force.
Survive to be the last one alive, take no hits for the whole match, and escape.
warnings: A single hit voids the attempt, so stealth and distance matter more than rescues here.

achievements.name: Campbell's Chapel Legacy
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the chapel and live to tell the tale.

steps: Find the Generator inside the chapel building.
Finish the repair and then escape the trial alive.

achievements.name: Cutting Out
achievements.description: In public matches, while The Killer is carrying you, wiggle out of The Killer's grasp 10 times.

steps: While on a Killer's shoulder, wiggle hard enough to break free — the wiggle bar fills faster near hooks the Killer has not found yet.
Ten successful wiggle-outs is cumulative across matches.

achievements.name: A bite for the Entity
achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice a total of 100 survivors.

steps: Sacrifice Survivors by hooking them until the Entity takes them.
100 sacrifices is cumulative and counts across every Killer you play.

achievements.name: Under Pressure
achievements.description: In public matches, perform 20 great skill checks while injured.

steps: Stay injured and work Generators or heal others — the Skill-Check prompts are what you are aiming at.
Land the small 'Great' zone (not just the good one) 20 times while injured.

achievements.name: Lifting The Fog
achievements.description: Reveal the Killer's aura 50 times in public matches.

steps: Reveal the Killer's Aura with aura-reading Perks, Items or add-ons.
Fifty reveals is cumulative; the counter ticks each time the outline appears, not each trial.

achievements.name: Chorus of Chaos
achievements.description: In public matches, make 30 unique survivors scream.

steps: Play a Killer and force 30 different individual Survivors to scream — each Survivor can only be counted once.
Powers and Perks that trigger screams are the whole method; you need many different players, not many screams.

achievements.name: Made it out alive!
achievements.description: In public matches, escape the match alive for a total of 100 times.

steps: Escape through an Exit Gate or the Hatch — dying on the hook or bleeding out does not count.
100 escapes is cumulative; a Survivor built around generators and gates banks them fastest.

achievements.name: Hemophobia
achievements.description: In a public match, escape the Disturbed Ward without losing a single drop of blood.

steps: Load the Disturbed Ward map and escape the trial without ever being injured — one hit fails it.
Play for pure stealth: hide, do Generators away from the Killer, and leave through the Exit Gate the moment it is powered.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: consistently named the most annoying trophy in the game by completionists — it needs both the right map and a hit-free trial in the same match.
warnings: Any damage at all — a hit, a trap, a Killer power — voids the attempt, and the map itself only comes up by chance.

achievements.name: Raccoon City Recruit
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator on the 1st floor of the RPD station’s main hall and escape.

steps: On the Raccoon City Police Department map, find the Generator in the main hall's 1st floor.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: Holiday Get-Together
achievements.description: In a public match, have at least 3 survivors hooked in the basement at the same time.

steps: Play a Killer on a map with a Basement and carry Survivors down to it.
Hook three of them in the Basement without any being unhooked — a Killer that can reach the Basement quickly, or a slow round, makes it possible.

achievements.name: Grim Pilgrimage
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the upper level of the Shrine and escape.

steps: Find the Generator on the upper level of the Shrine building.
Complete the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: Second Act
achievements.description: In public matches, recover from dying by yourself or with help 10 times.

steps: Recover from the Dying State back to Injured — either self-recovery or a team-mate's heal counts.
Ten recoveries is cumulative, so let yourself be downed and then get back up.

achievements.name: Selfless Survival
achievements.description: Heal a Survivor from the dying state to the injured state 30 times in public matches.

steps: Pick a downed Survivor back up to the Injured State — the short 'revive' interaction, not a full heal.
Thirty revives is cumulative across matches.

achievements.name: Practice Makes Perfect
achievements.description: In public matches, succeed in 100 healing or repair skill checks.

steps: Land the Skill-Check prompts that appear while repairing Generators or healing.
One hundred successful checks is cumulative; any Perk that adds more prompts speeds it up.

achievements.name: A Fast Death
achievements.description: Damage a Survivor with the Haste Status effect 8 times in public matches.

steps: Play a Killer and hit a Survivor who currently has the Haste status effect — Haste is granted by several Perks and add-ons.
Eight hits is cumulative; The Legion's Feral Frenzy and other speed-granting Killer powers make Haste common.

achievements.name: Game Over
achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice or kill 30 Survivors after the last Generator has been activated.

steps: Once the final Generator is repaired the Endgame Collapse begins — sacrifice or kill Survivors from that point on.
Thirty endgame kills is cumulative; Perks that punish the exit gates make the window much longer.

achievements.name: Shrine Apparatus
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Temple basement and live to tell the tale.

steps: Find the Generator in the Temple's basement.
Finish the repair and then escape the trial alive.

achievements.name: Awakened Anger
achievements.description: In public matches, damage a Survivor who just blinded you within 30 seconds.

steps: Play a Killer and let a Survivor blind you with a flashlight or firecracker.
Hit that same Survivor within 30 seconds — Lightborn removes the blind, so do not equip it.

achievements.name: Wounded Healer
achievements.description: In public matches, heal other Survivors for a total of 50 health states while you are also injured.

steps: Stay injured yourself and heal team-mates instead of patching up — both conditions must be true at the same time.
Fifty health states is cumulative; a med-kit makes the work much faster.

achievements.name: Broken Bodies
achievements.description: In public matches, hook a Survivor while 3 other Survivors are injured, 10 times.

steps: Play a Killer and injure three Survivors, then hook the fourth while all three are still injured.
Ten hooks is cumulative; spread damage early in the match rather than tunnelling one Survivor.

achievements.name: Serial Killer
achievements.description: In public matches, Sacrifice the Obsession 30 times.

steps: Each trial marks one Survivor as the Obsession — sacrifice that specific Survivor.
Thirty Obsession sacrifices is cumulative; Perks that keep the Obsession marked help guarantee the target.

achievements.name: Desperate Escape
achievements.description: In public matches, perform a fast vault within 3 seconds of getting hit 15 times.

steps: Take a hit and immediately fast-vault a window or pallet within three seconds.
Fifteen times is cumulative; intentionally run windows as the Killer closes in to force the window.

achievements.name: Flight to Freedom
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the eyrie and escape.

steps: Find the Generator in the eyrie, the elevated nest structure on the Eyrie of Crows map.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: End of Days
achievements.description: Hook 15 Survivors during the End Game Collapse in public matches.

steps: Wait for all Generators to be repaired so the Endgame Collapse begins, then hook Survivors.
Fifteen endgame hooks is cumulative; each Survivor can be hooked repeatedly during the collapse.

achievements.name: One More Step
achievements.description: In public matches, take a hit while you have the Endurance status effect 10 times.

steps: Get hit while Endurance is active — Endurance is granted by Perks such as Borrowed Time, Mettle of Man and Dead Hard.
Ten Endurance hits is cumulative; the effect must be up at the moment the hit lands.

achievements.name: Hero of Wallachia
achievements.description: In public matches, pallet stun the Killer 10 times while holding a rare, common, or uncommon item.

steps: Carry a common, uncommon or rare Item (not a higher rarity one) into the trial.
Land ten pallet stuns on the Killer while still holding it.

achievements.name: Master survivor
achievements.description: Reach survivor online grade Gold I.

steps: Play Survivor in public matches and keep earning Emblems without losing pips.
Gold I is several grade tiers above the starting rank; escaping often and taking protection hits is the fastest climb.

achievements.name: Insult and Injury
achievements.description: Escape a chase 50 times after stunning the Killer with a pallet in public matches.

steps: Stun the Killer with a dropped pallet, then break line of sight and escape the chase.
Fifty times is cumulative; the stun and the chase-escape must be in the same chase.

achievements.name: Lost All Hope
achievements.description: Down a Survivor within the bounds of any Exit Gate.

steps: Wait for the Exit Gates to be powered and a Survivor to run into the gate area.
Down them while they are inside the gate's bounds — do not let them cross the threshold first.

achievements.name: Devoted Gatekeeping
achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice all survivors before the last generator is repaired, 15 times.

steps: Get all four Survivors sacrificed, or killed, before the fifth Generator is finished.
Fifteen such matches is cumulative — high-pressure Killers and early slugs are the practical route.

achievements.name: A Worthy Opponent
achievements.description: In a single trial in public matches, be chased by the Killer for a total of 90 seconds.

steps: Survive a long, unbroken series of chases totalling 90 seconds inside one trial.
Perks such as Windows of Opportunity and Lithe let you loop the Killer far longer than usual.
warnings: The 90 seconds must all fall inside one match — a hit that ends a chase resets nothing, but dying does.

achievements.name: Texas BBQ
achievements.description: In public matches, hook 25 Survivors in the Basement. Once per Survivor per match.

steps: Play a Killer and carry Survivors down to the Basement to hook them there.
Each Survivor only counts once per match, so spread the Basement hooks across many trials.

achievements.name: Party Crasher
achievements.description: In public matches, damage a generator while at least 1 Survivor is Hooked, 100 times.

steps: Kick, or otherwise damage, a Generator while a Survivor is on a hook somewhere in the trial.
One hundred damaged generators is cumulative; kick every Generator you pass during a hook.

achievements.name: Outrage
achievements.description: In public matches, during a chase, damage a Survivor who drops a Pallet within a chase, 100 times.

steps: Chase a Survivor who drops a pallet, then hit them while the chase is still active.
One hundred hits is cumulative; swing through or around the dropped pallet immediately to keep the chase alive.

achievements.name: Happy Holidays
achievements.description: Open at least 100 mystery boxes on the bloodweb (available during select special events).

steps: During an event that puts Mystery Boxes on the Bloodweb, open them as you level characters.
One hundred boxes is cumulative across characters and events.
warnings: Mystery Boxes only appear on the Bloodweb during select seasonal events, so this cannot be progressed all year round.

achievements.name: Looter
achievements.description: In public matches, unlock 100 chests.

steps: Find and open the Chests scattered around each trial — one search each.
One hundred chests is cumulative; the Plunderer's Instinct Perk reveals them so you never walk past one.

achievements.name: Whiffing to Success
achievements.description: In public matches, cause the killer to miss an attack before taking a vault, 50 times.

steps: Bait a Killer's swing and dodge it, then immediately vault a window or pallet.
Fifty times is cumulative; the vault must come right after the missed attack.

achievements.name: Share the Pain
achievements.description: In a public match as a Killer, have all four Survivors injured at the same time.

steps: Play a Killer and injure each Survivor once, without letting the first ones heal.
Get all four into the injured state simultaneously — spread pressure early rather than committing to one chase.

achievements.name: Outrun the Overlap
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the main house in the Garden of Joy and escape.

steps: On the Garden of Joy map, find the Generator inside the main house.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: I See You
achievements.description: Down 30 Survivors suffering from the Exposed status effect in public matches.

steps: Play a Killer whose power or Perks apply Exposed, then down Survivors while it is active.
Thirty downs is cumulative; Perks such as No One Escapes Death and Make Your Choice apply it on demand.

achievements.name: Rebuilding The Borgo
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the main house in the Shattered Square and escape.

steps: On The Shattered Square map, find the Generator inside the main house.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: Heavy Burden
achievements.description: In public matches, hit 25 different individual Survivors while carrying another Survivor.

steps: Pick up a downed Survivor, then hit a different one while still carrying them.
Twenty-five different individual Survivors must be hit this way, so it takes many trials.

achievements.name: The Show Must Go On
achievements.description: In public matches, finish repairing 10 generators while injured.

steps: Stay injured and be the one who lands the final charge on a Generator.
Ten finished Generators is cumulative; avoid healing until the generator is complete.

achievements.name: Expert Killer
achievements.description: Reach killer online grade Silver I.

steps: Play Killer in public matches and keep earning Emblems without losing pips.
Silver I is a couple of grade tiers above the starting rank and comes from consistent sacrifices and chases.

achievements.name: Prowler
achievements.description: Detect 100 Survivors with Killer Instinct in public matches.

steps: Play a Killer whose power triggers Killer Instinct, and let it find Survivors for you.
One hundred detections is cumulative; powers such as The Legion's Feral Frenzy and The Doctor's static blast make it constant.

achievements.name: Triage
achievements.description: When a Survivor is injured far away, heal them 30 times without travelling more than 16 meters.

steps: Heal a Survivor who is far from you, moving no more than 16 metres to reach them.
Thirty heals is cumulative; Perks or Items that reveal distant injured Survivors make the setup reliable.

achievements.name: High Speed Pursuit
achievements.description: As a Killer, vault 50 times while chasing Survivors in public matches.

steps: Play a Killer and vault a window or pallet while actively chasing a Survivor.
Fifty chases vaults is cumulative; chase Survivors through window-heavy loops to force them.

achievements.name: Extraterrestrial
achievements.description: In a public match, complete the generator at the base on Toba Landing and escape.

steps: On the Toba Landing map, find the Generator at the research base.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: MU/TH/UR Dearest
achievements.description: In a public match, complete the generator at the mess hall in the Nostromo Wreckage and escape.

steps: On the Nostromo Wreckage map, find the Generator in the mess hall.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: Neither Seen Nor Heard
achievements.description: Apply the Oblivious status effect to Survivors 30 times in public matches.

steps: Play a Killer whose power or Perks apply Oblivious — it hides the Survivor's terror radius cues.
Thirty applications is cumulative; Perks such as Hex: Plaything apply it easily.

achievements.name: Blood in your mouth
achievements.description: Kill Survivors by your own hands a total of 25 times.

steps: Kill Survivors directly rather than sacrificing them — bring a Memento Mori offering, or use a Killer with an in-built kill such as The Shape, The Pig's Reverse Bear Traps or The Trapper's traps.
Twenty-five direct kills is cumulative across matches.
warnings: A sacrifice on a hook or a bleed-out does not count — the kill has to be by your own hands.

achievements.name: Death of Ignorance
achievements.description: Down a Survivor suffering from the Oblivious status effect 15 times in public matches.

steps: Apply Oblivious to a Survivor, then down them while the status is still active.
Fifteen downs is cumulative; Perks such as Hex: Plaything and The Nemesis's Zombies apply Oblivious for you.

achievements.name: Complete the Evolution
achievements.description: In public matches, injure or down 3 Survivors who are Hindered.

steps: Play a Killer and injure or down Survivors who currently have the Hindered status effect — Hindered slows them down.
Three Survivors is all it takes; Hindered is applied by Perks such as Hex: The Third Seal and by several Killer powers.

achievements.name: Legendary survivor
achievements.description: Reach survivor online grade Iridescent I.

steps: Play Survivor in public matches and climb the grade ladder to Iridescent I — the highest rank available.
You must earn Emblems consistently for a long stretch without losing pips; this is one of the biggest Survivor grinds in the game.

achievements.name: Resourceful
achievements.description: In public matches, swap held Survivor items for new ones from chests 10 times (max once per chest).

steps: Carry an Item to a Chest and swap it for the Chest's contents.
Only the first swap per Chest counts, so ten swaps needs several trials.

achievements.name: Prized Possession
achievements.description: As a Killer, finish a public match with at least one Hex totem standing.

steps: Equip a Hex Perk so a Hex Totem spawns in the trial, and defend it rather than letting Survivors cleanse it.
Finish the match — win or lose — with that Hex Totem still lit.

achievements.name: Mad House
achievements.description: In a public match, bring the 4 survivors to insanity Tier 3 at least once in the same match.

steps: Play The Doctor and use Shock Therapy and Static Blast to raise every Survivor's Madness to Tier 3.
All four Survivors must reach Tier 3 at least once within the same trial.

achievements.name: Jump Scares
achievements.description: In public matches, with the Wraith, Surprise & hit a total of 100 survivors.

steps: Play The Wraith and land hits on Survivors while breaking out of cloak — the 'Surprise' attack.
One hundred surprise hits is cumulative; the All-Seeing add-ons keep Survivors visible while cloaked.

achievements.name: Denied!
achievements.description: In public matches, close the hatch 30 times.

steps: Play a Killer, keep at least one Survivor alive, and be the first to the Hatch so you can close it.
Thirty Hatch closes is cumulative; the Hatch only appears once one Survivor remains.

achievements.name: Power Moves
achievements.description: Equip 0 perks, repair generators for a total of 1 full repair and escape 8 times in public matches.

steps: Equip no Perks at all, repair at least one full Generator's worth of charges, and escape alive.
Repeat eight times — the escape is the hard part with no Perks to help.
warnings: Equipping even one Perk voids the match; the repair and the escape must both happen in that same no-Perk trial.

achievements.name: Kitted Out
achievements.description: In 35 different public matches, pick up and use at least one Special Item as a Survivor.

steps: Special Items are found in Chests or dropped by the Killer — pick one up and use it.
Thirty-five different matches are required, so it is one per trial.

achievements.name: Hack the Mainframe
achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator by the command center on Shelter Woods and escape.

steps: On the Shelter Woods map, find the Generator beside the command center building.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: Blood on your face
achievements.description: Kill all four Survivors by your own hands in a single Trial.

steps: Kill all four Survivors directly in one trial rather than sacrificing them — a Memento Mori, or a Killer with an in-built kill such as The Shape or The Pig.
You need four direct kills inside a single match, which usually means the Survivors cooperate.
warnings: Sacrifices on hooks do not count, so the whole trial has to be built around direct kills.

achievements.name: From the Deep
achievements.description: Grab a Survivor hiding inside a locker 25 times in public matches.

steps: Play a Killer and grab a Survivor who is hiding inside a Locker.
Twenty-five locker grabs is cumulative; perks and powers that reveal hiding Survivors make it far quicker.

achievements.name: Master Manipulator
achievements.description: In public matches, damage a Survivor while they are healing another or repairing 5 times.

steps: Play a Killer and interrupt a Survivor who is mid-heal or mid-repair by hitting them.
Five interruptions is all that is needed; approach generators quietly so the target does not stop working.

achievements.name: Stranger Sightings
achievements.description: Reveal or see the Killer's aura 11 times in a single trial in a public match.

steps: Run aura-reading Perks or Items and keep the Killer's outline appearing and dropping.
All eleven reveals must happen inside one trial — Perks with short, repeated aura pings are ideal.

achievements.name: Milk 'n' Cookies
achievements.description: In a public match, take the item from the chest in the basement in at least 30 different trials.

steps: On a map with a Basement, find the Chest inside the Basement and take its Item.
Thirty different trials are required, and the Basement only appears on some maps — so this takes a long time.

achievements.name: None the Wiser
achievements.description: In public matches, hit 5 Survivors that are Oblivious.

steps: Apply Oblivious to Survivors and then hit them while the status is up.
Only five hits are needed; Perks such as Hex: Plaything apply Oblivious automatically.

achievements.name: Left For Dead
achievements.description: As the last person still alive, activate the last generator and escape through the exit gate.

steps: Be the only Survivor left alive, then personally finish the last Generator yourself.
Escape through an Exit Gate — the Hatch does not satisfy this one, so you must power and open a gate.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: repeatedly named one of the hardest trophies in the game — you need the other three Survivors gone, one Generator left, and enough time to finish it and open a gate alone.
warnings: The Hatch escape does not count; it has to be the last Generator plus an Exit Gate.

achievements.name: Outta Nowhere
achievements.description: In public matches, hit 40 Survivors with a basic attack while you are Undetectable.

steps: Play a Killer that can become Undetectable — The Wraith, Ghost Face, The Shape, The Pig — and land basic attacks while cloaked or sneaking.
Forty hits is cumulative across matches.

achievements.name: Ever Vigilant
achievements.description: In public matches, complete 20 healing actions on Survivors once all generators have been completed.

steps: Repair all five Generators first, then heal team-mates during the Endgame Collapse.
Twenty heals is cumulative; sticking close to injured Survivors after the gates are powered is the whole method.

achievements.name: Movie Buff
achievements.description: In a public match, complete the generator inside the movie theater in Greenville Square and escape.

steps: On the Greenville Square map, find the Generator inside the movie theater.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: Devoted Caretaker
achievements.description: In a single trial in public matches, heal the Obsession 3 times.

steps: Find the Obsession — the Survivor with the black-and-white portrait — and heal them.
Heal that same Survivor three separate times inside one trial.

achievements.name: Master Killer
achievements.description: Reach killer online grade Gold I.

steps: Play Killer in public matches and climb to Gold I, several tiers above the starting rank.
Keep earning Emblems without losing pips — consistent sacrifices and long chases do it fastest.

achievements.name: Dismantle
achievements.description: In public matches, break a total of 50 individual Hooks.

steps: Sabotage Hooks with a Toolbox, or with the Saboteur Perk, until they break.
Fifty different individual Hooks is cumulative; a toolbox with a sabotage add-on makes each one quick.

achievements.name: Final Days
achievements.description: In public matches, take 10 protection hits during the Endgame Collapse.

steps: Once the Endgame Collapse begins, put yourself between the Killer and a team-mate and take the hit.
Ten protection hits is cumulative, and only hits taken during the collapse count.

achievements.name: Adept Meg
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Meg using only her 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Meg Thomas with only her three unique Perks equipped — Sprint Burst, Quick & Quiet and Adrenaline — and no others.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Any fourth Perk, or replacing one of hers, invalidates the attempt for that match.

achievements.name: Bodyguard
achievements.description: In public matches, take a protection hit while the Killer is carrying a Survivor, 30 times.

steps: Intercept the Killer while they are carrying a downed Survivor and take the hit yourself.
Thirty protection hits is cumulative; running near a carrying Killer is the trigger.

achievements.name: Adept Claudette
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Claudette using only her 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Claudette Morel with only her three unique Perks — Empathy, Botany Knowledge and Self-Care — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Do not slot any other Perk, or the trial will not count.

achievements.name: Dungeon Crawler
achievements.description: In a public match, complete the generator inside the torture room in the Forgotten Ruins and escape.

steps: On the Forgotten Ruins map, find the Generator inside the torture room.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: The Key to Escape
achievements.description: Escape through the Hatch after opening it with a Key.

steps: Bring a Skeleton Key (or a Key with the right add-ons) into a public trial.
Open the Hatch with the Key, then escape through it — the Key lets you do this before you are the last Survivor.

achievements.name: Deranged Pursuit
achievements.description: In public matches, as the Legion, down 25 different Survivors that have Deep Wound applied.

steps: Play The Legion and use Feral Frenzy to apply Deep Wound, then down those Survivors.
Twenty-five different individual Survivors must be downed this way, so it takes many matches.

achievements.name: Ghost in the Machine
achievements.description: Damage 50 generators while Undetectable in public matches.

steps: Kick Generators while your Killer is Undetectable — cloaked as The Wraith, crouched as The Pig, or hidden as Ghost Face.
Fifty damaged Generators is cumulative across matches.

achievements.name: Shine On
achievements.description: In public matches, blind the Killer with a flashlight 30 times.

steps: Carry a Flashlight and blind the Killer with a full beam — aim for the face while they are carrying or breaking a pallet.
Thirty blinds is cumulative; the Flashlight's add-ons widen the blind window.

achievements.name: Tanuki in the Fog
achievements.description: Discover a hidden Guardian at the Yamaoka Estate.

steps: Load into one of the two Yamaoka Estate maps — Family Residence or Sanctum of Wrath.
Search the map for the small Tanuki statue, most often near the outer walls, then stand next to it until it breaks and the creature yowls.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: the statue is not guaranteed to spawn on every Yamaoka Estate trial, and its position varies, so it usually takes several matches of searching the perimeter.
warnings: The statue's spawn is random — you may need many Yamaoka Estate trials before it appears.

achievements.name: Rescue Mission
achievements.description: Stun the Killer with a pallet while they are carrying a Survivor 5 times.

steps: Follow the Killer while they are carrying a downed Survivor and drop a pallet on them.
Five pallet stuns on a carrying Killer is cumulative across matches.

achievements.name: Disarm and Dismember
achievements.description: In public matches, hit 50 Survivors holding a Special Item.

steps: Play a Killer and hit Survivors who are currently holding a Special Item.
Fifty hits is cumulative; Special Items are those found in Chests or dropped rather than brought into the trial.

achievements.name: Silent Approach
achievements.description: In public matches, interrupt and grab 25 Survivors while they are repairing generators.

steps: Play a Killer that can approach Undetectable and grab a Survivor off a Generator by reaching them unseen.
The grab works when the Survivor does not see you coming — twenty-five of them is cumulative.

achievements.name: Adept Dwight
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Dwight using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Dwight Fairfield with only his three unique Perks — Bond, Prove Thyself and Leader — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Only those three Perks; any extra slot filled with something else voids the match.

achievements.name: In Pursuit
achievements.description: In public matches, down 13 Survivors within 30 seconds of breaking a Pallet or Wall.

steps: Break a pallet or a breakable wall and then down a Survivor within 30 seconds.
Thirteen times is cumulative — break walls mid-chase to keep the timer relevant.

achievements.name: Deep Cleansing
achievements.description: In public matches, cleanse 100 Hex totems.

steps: Cleanse Hex Totems — the lit ones, not the dull Dull Totems — by holding the interaction until they break.
One hundred Hex Totems is cumulative; the Small Game or Detective's Hunch Perks reveal them.

achievements.name: Legendary Killer
achievements.description: Reach Killer Iridescent I.

steps: Play Killer in public matches and climb the grade ladder to Iridescent I — the highest rank available.
It demands a long run of strong Emblem scores without losing pips, and is one of the biggest Killer grinds in the game.

achievements.name: Even Punishment
achievements.description: In a public match, teleport to your Phantasm traps and hit all 4 individual survivors at least once.

steps: Play The Hag, place Phantasm Traps around the map, and teleport to them when Survivors trigger them.
Hit each of the four Survivors at least once in the same trial.

achievements.name: Bound and Downed
achievements.description: Down speared Survivors 30 times with The Deathslinger in public matches.

steps: Play The Deathslinger, spear a Survivor with the Redeemer, then reel them in and down them.
Thirty speared downs is cumulative; add-ons that speed up the reel make it much easier.

achievements.name: Adept Jake
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Jake using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Jake Park with only his three unique Perks — Iron Will, Calm Spirit and Saboteur — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: No fourth Perk is allowed for the match to count.

achievements.name: Speed Kills
achievements.description: Hit 30 survivors with a Lethal Rush in public matches.

steps: Play The Blight and hit Survivors during a Lethal Rush — the charge attack after bouncing off scenery.
Thirty hits is cumulative; aim your bounces so you slam straight into a Survivor.

achievements.name: A feast for the Entity
achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice a total of 1000 survivors.

steps: Sacrifice Survivors by hooking them until the Entity claims them.
One thousand sacrifices is cumulative and is one of the single longest grinds in the game — expect hundreds of hours of Killer play.

achievements.name: Taste the Darkness
achievements.description: In public matches, interrupt 10 Survivors while they are performing a vault.

steps: Hit a Survivor in the middle of a vault so the animation is interrupted.
Ten interrupted vaults is cumulative; hit as the Survivor commits to the window or pallet.

achievements.name: Conniption
achievements.description: In public matches, with The Spirit, use Yamaoka's Haunting to down 30 Survivors.

steps: Play The Spirit and down Survivors using Yamaoka's Haunting — the phase-walk into a strike.
Thirty downs is cumulative.

achievements.name: One Thousand Cuts
achievements.description: Deal maximum Laceration on Survivors 50 times in public matches.

steps: Play The Trickster and throw knives until a Survivor reaches maximum Laceration.
Fifty maximum-Laceration hits is cumulative; keep the knife stream steady rather than throwing in bursts.

achievements.name: Key to Success
achievements.description: In a public match, use a key to open a chest.

steps: Bring a Key into a public trial.
Find a Chest and hold the interaction to open it — the Key is spent on the search.

achievements.name: Above Judgment
achievements.description: In a public match, escape The Judgment's Exile without being hit by Seeds of Punishment.

steps: Survive a trial against The Judgment and reach the Exile without taking a hit from Seeds of Punishment.
Keep distance whenever the punishment ability is charging and escape at the end.

achievements.name: Hand-Eye Coordination
achievements.description: Find and use the Hand or Eye of Vecna and escape a Trial.

steps: Find the Hand or Eye of Vecna, the special item that only appears on specific maps, and interact with it.
Then escape the trial alive — both halves must happen in the same match.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: widely listed among the hardest trophies because the Vecna item is a rare, map-dependent spawn and you also have to escape with it.
warnings: The item's spawn depends on the map rotated into the trial, so most attempts never see it at all.

achievements.name: Beyond Broken
achievements.description: Injure a Survivor afflicted by the Broken Status Effect with a Basic Attack a total of 50 times.

steps: Play a Killer and use a basic attack on a Survivor who currently has the Broken status effect.
Fifty such hits is cumulative; Perks such as Hex: The Third Seal and Sloppy Butcher help keep Survivors Broken.

achievements.name: Death Flight
achievements.description: Injure Survivors after you vaulted during a chase 20 times in public matches.

steps: Play a Killer, vault a window or pallet during a chase, then injure a Survivor shortly afterwards.
Twenty times is cumulative; the vault has to be part of the chase that ends in the hit.

achievements.name: Adept Nea
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Nea using only her 3 unique perks

steps: Play as Nea Karlsson with only her three unique Perks — Balanced Landing, Urban Evasion and Streetwise — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Any extra Perk invalidates the attempt for that match.

achievements.name: Adept Bill
achievements.description: Escape with Bill using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Bill Overbeck with only his three unique Perks — Left Behind, Borrowed Time and Unbreakable — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: No other Perk may be slotted.

achievements.name: Multi-tasker
achievements.description: Down 30 Survivors while carrying another Survivor in public matches.

steps: Pick up a downed Survivor, then down a second Survivor while still carrying the first.
Thirty such downs is cumulative across matches.

achievements.name: Taking One For The Team
achievements.description: Protect a recently unhooked Survivor by taking a hit near them 250 times.

steps: Take a protection hit right next to a Survivor who has just been unhooked.
Two hundred and fifty times is cumulative — one of the longest Survivor grinds, so run perks that reward protection hits.

achievements.name: Viral Video
achievements.description: Apply Condemned on Survivors 30 times in public matches.

steps: Play Sadako / The Onryō and apply the Condemned status effect to Survivors.
Thirty applications is cumulative; Condemned builds from the tape-based power.

achievements.name: Deadly Plunge
achievements.description: In public matches, as a Killer, fall a combined distance of 1000 meters.

steps: Play a Killer on maps with verticality and deliberately drop off ledges and upper floors during matches.
One thousand metres of falling is cumulative across every trial.

achievements.name: Butcherin'
achievements.description: In public matches, with The Cannibal, successfully chainsaw a total of 100 times.

steps: Play The Cannibal and land the chainsaw attack on Survivors.
One hundred successful chainsaws is cumulative — the chainsaw sprint is safest to use in the open or against a cornered Survivor.

achievements.name: Adept Trapper
achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with the Trapper using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as The Trapper with only his three unique Perks — Unnerving Presence, Brutal Strength and Agitation — equipped.
Achieve a Merciless Victory, which means sacrificing or killing all four Survivors in the trial.
warnings: Merciless Victory requires all four Survivors eliminated; a 3-kill match does not count.

achievements.name: Adept Min
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Min using only her 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Feng Min with only her three unique Perks — Technician, Lithe and Alert — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Any Perk beyond her three voids the match.

achievements.name: Swirling Death
achievements.description: In public matches, throw 1000 Hatchets.

steps: Play The Huntress and throw your Hatchets — they do not have to hit to count.
One thousand throws is cumulative and is a pure volume grind; throw at every opportunity, hit or miss.

achievements.name: Don’t Open, Dead Inside
achievements.description: In a public match, complete the generator at the Fallen Refuge and escape.

steps: On the Fallen Refuge map, find the Generator at the map's main structure.
Finish the repair and escape the trial.

achievements.name: The Grind
achievements.description: In public matches, with the Hillbilly, chainsaw a total of 100 survivors.

steps: Play The Hillbilly and connect the chainsaw sprint attack on Survivors.
One hundred chainsaw hits is cumulative; the chainsaw cannot be landed point-blank, so charge it from mid-range.

achievements.name: Adept David
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with David using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as David King with only his three unique Perks — We're Gonna Live Forever, Dead Hard and No Mither — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: No Mither leaves you permanently injured, so the escape is genuinely difficult.

achievements.name: Break For It
achievements.description: In public matches, escape a match while being Broken a total of 5 times.

steps: Escape the trial while the Broken status effect is active — Broken blocks all healing.
Five Broken escapes is cumulative; Perks that apply Broken to you are the most reliable route.

achievements.name: Adept Wraith
achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with the Wraith using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as The Wraith with only his three unique Perks — Predator, Bloodhound and Shadowborn — equipped.
Achieve a Merciless Victory by eliminating all four Survivors in the trial.
warnings: All four Survivors must be sacrificed or killed; three is not enough.

achievements.name: Dream Demon
achievements.description: In public matches, pull 200 Survivors into the Dream World.

steps: Play The Nightmare and pull Survivors into the Dream World with your power.
Two hundred pulls is cumulative; Survivors pulled repeatedly in one match all count.

achievements.name: Terminal Illness
achievements.description: In public matches, with The Plague, down 50 Survivors affected by the maximum infection.

steps: Play The Plague and infect Survivors until they reach maximum Infection, then down them.
Fifty downs is cumulative; the Corrupt Purge makes finishing infected Survivors much easier.

achievements.name: Totally Vulnerable
achievements.description: In public matches, with Ghost Face, down 50 Marked Survivors.

steps: Play Ghost Face, stalk Survivors to Mark them, then down them while Marked.
Fifty Marked downs is cumulative; stalking from concealment is the key to applying Marks reliably.

achievements.name: Bloodied Hands
achievements.description: In public matches, safely unhook Survivors while being Broken a total of 10 times.

steps: Unhook a Survivor while you have the Broken status effect active.
Ten such unhooks is cumulative; Broken is applied to you by Perks such as No Mither or Hex traps.

achievements.name: Adept Kate
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Kate, using only her 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Kate Denson with only her three unique Perks — Dance With Me, Windows of Opportunity and Boil Over — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Any fourth Perk voids the attempt.

achievements.name: Adept Hillbilly
achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with the Hillbilly using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as The Hillbilly with only his three unique Perks — Enduring, Lightborn and Tinkerer — equipped.
Achieve a Merciless Victory by eliminating all four Survivors.
warnings: All four Survivors must go down; a 3-kill trial does not award it.

achievements.name: Biological Weaponry
achievements.description: Down Contaminated Survivors with The Nemesis 65 times in public matches using Tentacle Strike.

steps: Play The Nemesis, Contaminate Survivors with a Tentacle Strike, then down them with it.
Sixty-five downs is cumulative; the Tentacle Strike's second tier of Contamination is what lets it down.

achievements.name: Deadly Obsession
achievements.description: In public matches, hook the Obsession 300 times.

steps: Each trial marks one Survivor as the Obsession — hook that Survivor as often as you can.
Three hundred Obsession hooks is a very long cumulative grind.

achievements.name: Not Today
achievements.description: In public matches, unhook yourself 50 times.

steps: Free yourself from a hook — either the base 4% self-unhook attempt or the Deliverance Perk.
Fifty self-unhooks is cumulative; Deliverance guarantees one per match when you have unhooked someone else first.

achievements.name: Terror of LV-426
achievements.description: In public matches, hit 30 Survivors using a Tail attack.

steps: Play The Xenomorph and hit Survivors with the Tail attack.
Thirty tail hits is cumulative; the tail has a long reach but a wind-up that Survivors can dodge.

achievements.name: What Lurks Beneath
achievements.description: In public matches, injure Survivors while in the Basement 25 times.

steps: Play a Killer and injure Survivors while you are physically inside the Basement.
Twenty-five injures is cumulative; lure Survivors to the Basement, or catch them rescuing there.

achievements.name: In the void she walks
achievements.description: In public matches, with the Nurse, blink and successfully land an attack a total of 500 times.

steps: Play The Nurse and land an attack immediately after a Blink.
Five hundred blinks into hits is cumulative and requires real mastery of the Blink timing.

achievements.name: Adept Ace
achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Ace using only his 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as Ace Visconti with only his three unique Perks — Open-Handed, Up the Ante and Ace in the Hole — equipped.
Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Slotting any other Perk voids the match.

achievements.name: Shocking Treatment
achievements.description: In public matches, hit survivors 500 times with The Doctor's Shock Therapy attack.

steps: Play The Doctor and hit Survivors with Shock Therapy — the short-range burst, not the Static Blast.
Five hundred Shock Therapy hits is cumulative and is a long grind.

achievements.name: Adept Huntress
achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Huntress using only her 3 unique perks.

steps: Play as The Huntress with only her three unique Perks — Beast of Prey, Territorial Imperative and Huntress Lullaby — equipped.
Achieve a Merciless Victory by eliminating all four Survivors.
warnings: All four Survivors must be sacrificed or killed, which is hard with no Perk support for the chase.

steps: Play The Lich and collect the Hand or Eye of Vecna during the trial.
Then kill or sacrifice all four Survivors in that same match.
warnings: Both halves must happen in one match, and the Vecna item spawns only on certain maps.

Escape a public trial alive.
warnings: Either character works, but only those three Perks.

steps: Play as The Judgment and let a Survivor Taunt you so the Heresy status effect is applied to them.
Then Exile that specific Survivor using your power.
warnings: The Survivor has to gain Heresy from taunting and then be Exiled, so you must track which one it was.

achievements.name: Roadblocks
achievements.description: In a single match, block the same Pallet 3 times.

steps: Play a Killer that can block or rebreak a pallet and return to the same pallet three times in one match.

warnings: All three blocks must be on the same pallet within one match, which depends on the Survivors looping it repeatedly.
